notes:
## New features
- **Include or exclude a source in the current time slice** from its right-click menu, or with the new *Include in <slice>* switch in the Inspector. It applies to every selected source and is one undoable step.
- **Car park inputs follow your time slices.** There is one movement rate per slice the project uses (Day and Night, Single Hour, or all three), and the size is entered plainly as *Number of parking spaces*, floor area or beds. The emission method and saved values are unchanged.
- **dB label halo** is now an option (Labels › Halo) and is off by default.
- If AURIS ever stops responding for more than three seconds, it records where it was in `~/Library/Logs/AURIS/stalls.log`, so a freeze can be traced and fixed.

## Changes
- **Smoother, more accurate contours.** SmartSmooth and the interpolated raster now read a bounded cubic field instead of straight-sided triangles. Against known exact fields this is 3 to 10 times more accurate, grid-scale kinks fall from 5 to 12 degrees to about 2, there is no overshoot, and calculated nodes are kept exactly. Shadow boundaries behind buildings stay sharp.
- **Native CRTN contours are about 7 times faster** (P1930 at 4 m: 313 s to 46 s). The paragraph 11 ground check now uses the slope of the terrain the propagation paths actually cross, instead of the steepest slope anywhere on the site. Levels move by 0.03 dB on average and at most 0.10 dB, because roads are split into fewer segments that still meet the 2 dB rule. Dense transects show no new steps.
- Screening-transition validation does less repeated work for the same result (identical contours on P1995).
- **Settings:** the second tab is now called *Global*. It holds settings for every project on this Mac; the Project tab holds settings saved with the open project.
- The Studio sheet look has a 22 mm logo, and a bordered contour scale lines up with the cards above it. The footer date fits on one line.
- Parking areas no longer draw a large P on the map; the key still shows it.
- The Results *More* menu, the Inputs report menu and the section right-click menu use the app's menu style.

## Bug fixes
- **Crash:** closing the Scenario Manager could crash AURIS minutes later. Closed Scenario Manager and Settings dialogs are now cleaned up straight away.
- Opening another project while the Contours sheet was locked kept the previous project's sheet, frame and title on screen.
- Marker sizes changed in one project carried over to the next project opened. They now stay with each project, and saved sizes only seed new projects.
- CRTN contour nodes beside gently curving roads could be left blank for review (19 of 117 on a P1930 test grid). These now calculate. Other nodes on that grid moved by at most 0.06 dB.
- Choosing the *Monochrome print* sheet look kept the previous look.
- In map-only sheets the scale bar touched the neatline.
- The car park tool kept the time slices of the first project opened, for example showing Day and Night in a Single Hour project.
